requirements.title: Directed send
requirements.description: Multiple deck builders, each with one or more Present children. Each Present belongs to one deck. Posts go only to the chosen child Window. Send to a named child, or to all children of that deck only. Other decks never receive it. Missing target sends to nobody. Kill the shared BroadcastChannel / handleSendClick / PresentData path for slide payloads. Main owns the session graph. Four fixed channels. Logical child, not Electron parent. New Present window gets a new id. Main caches last payload and replays it if that Present reloads.

requirements.title: Single Home
requirements.description: Home/Library is the one main window, the list of saved presentations/decks. Only one Home. Opening Home again focuses the existing one. Present windows are where slides play. Open Presentation opens a deck window; Home stays put.

requirements.title: Theme persist
requirements.description: Remember the selected theme, including the dropdown, on app restart and when the main window is closed and opened again. Apply that theme to Home, deck builders, and Present windows.

requirements.title: Program thumbnail
requirements.description: In the deck, a thumbnail of what is on program.

todos.content: Replace the shared BroadcastChannel / handleSendClick / PresentData slide bus with a Main-owned session graph and four fixed channels so a deck posts only to the chosen Present Window.

Support send to named child presentIds, or all children of that deck only; missing targets send to nobody; another deck's id is a no-op; new Present window gets a new id; replay last payload if that Present reloads.

Keep Home/Library as the only main window (the saved presentations/decks list); opening Home again focuses the existing Home; Open Presentation opens a deck window while Home stays put; Present windows are where slides play.
Persist the selected theme including the dropdown across app restart and across Home close/reopen, and apply it to Home, deck builders, and Present windows.
Show a thumbnail in the deck of what is on program.

acceptanceCriteria: Deck A send-to-A1 does not show on A2 or any B Present.
Deck A send-to-all-its-children does not show on B.
Deck B cannot drive A's children (including by guessing an id).
Closing a Present drops it from that deck's list. Reopen gets a new presentId.
Reloading a Present still shows the last payload Main cached for it.
Only one Home/Library exists. Opening Home again focuses the original Home. Home is the saved-deck list. Present windows play slides. Open Presentation leaves Home in place and opens a deck window.
After choosing a theme (dropdown shows it), quit and reopen the app: the same theme is applied on Home, decks, and Presents, and the dropdown still shows that choice.
Close the main Home window and open it again: same theme restore as above.
A deck shows a thumbnail of what is on program.
Slide payloads are not sent on BroadcastChannel.

selected.reason: directed-send-main-switch passes QA. Graph has send target/all and session-scoped presentIds (shared/posterSessionGraph.cjs) but DeckBuilder always sends target=all with no child picker, no onDeckEvent child list, and no multi-deck isolation tests. Epic validation criteria 1-4 for REQ-001 depend on this task before single-home or thumbnail work.

planningNotes: Baseline (loop 4 search): SessionTransport.send(payload, target?) and graph handleDeckCommand support named presentId or all; missing target yields empty deliver list. handlePresentEvent rejects ready when presentId not in session (cross-deck guess is no-op). DeckBuilder handleSendClick calls send(payload) without target; only Open Present spawns one child. No deck UI for present child list, send-to-selected, or close child. posterSessionGraph.test.js covers single deck send+replay only. E2E specs (remix-visual-regression, lyrics-navigation, alignment-grid) still inject via BroadcastChannel — migrate to session spawn/send in this task or immediately after deck targeting UI lands.
